diaspora_bullets: Every Indian American who won a House race is a Democrat
Nithya Raman won the Los Angeles mayor's race, defeating Karen Bass
news_summary: Six Indian Americans were elected to the US House in the November 3 midterms, matching the community's record, while Vivek Ramaswamy lost his bid for Ohio governor.
payoff: The entire group will be part of the majority starting in January.
